messages.subject: calculating pkde - error
parts:
Hi Chris,

I'm trying to calculate a pkde for 15 animals during a seasonal period in one year to test the process. I think I have the data set up correctly as the function seems to run, but eventually it produces the error: 

Error in get.telemetry(data, TMM$axes) :argument "data" is missing, with no default

The code to generate this error is:
pop_estimate = pkde(data = DATA, UD = uds, kernel = "individual", weights = FALSE, ref = "Gaussian")

Where DATA is the telemetry object for the animals, and uds are the list of UD objects that match the animals in DATA. 

What are the "data" the error is referring to? Probably something simple I'm missing, but I would appreciate any guidance!

Many thanks!

The full output of the function is:

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: calculating pkde - error
parts:
Hi,

DATA needs to be a list of telemetry objects (with the same length as uds) and not just one telemetry object.

Best,
Chris
